lines.en: if gpmexc == True:
scene gpmexc1 with dissolve
: Hmm...
scene gpmexc2 with dissolve
: What’s wrong, Akira? We’ve already been over here.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Akira？我们已经来过这边了。

lines.en: : You’re not lost already, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会已经迷路了吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. I know exactly what I’m doing.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我清楚得很自己在干什么。

lines.en: else:
scene gpmexc1 with dissolve2
$ renpy.pause(2, hard=True)
scene gpmexc2 with dissolve2
: Woooooooow! I haven’t seen a tunnel {i}this{/i} huge since I got stuck in the Infinite Waterslide!
lines.zh: : 哇哦哦哦哦哦！自从我被卡在无限滑水道里那次之后，我就没见过{i}这么{/i}大的隧道！

lines.en: : Do they have tunnels where you come from, Akira?
lines.zh: : 你来的地方有隧道吗，Akira？

lines.en: : They do. Waterslides, too. Though, I don’t think any of ours are infinite.
lines.zh: : 有。滑水道也有。不过我想我们的没一个是无限的。

lines.en: : The one in the mall isn’t technically {i}infinite{/i} either. It just goes on for about ten miles with speeds gradually increasing the longer you’re falling.
lines.zh: : 商场里那个严格来说也{i}不是{/i}无限的。它只是大约有十英里长，而且你落得越久速度越快。

lines.en: : The only reason I managed to make it out unscathed is because I encountered a temporal rift along the way.
lines.zh: : 我能毫发无伤地出来，唯一的原因是我在路上遇到了一道时间裂隙。

lines.en: : I’m glad I did too! Because I was starting to zone out from all of the colors. Hahah!
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴遇上了！因为我开始被那些颜色晃得走神了。哈哈！

lines.en: : This would be a much nicer place to get stuck in, I think. Especially since I have you with-
lines.zh: : 我觉得这地方困在里面会好得多。尤其是有你陪——

lines.en: : AAAHHH!
lines.zh: : AAAHHH!

lines.en: : Amy? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : Amy？怎么了？

lines.en: : Look through the vines! Quick!
lines.zh: : 透过那些藤蔓看！快！

lines.en: scene gpmexc1
I make my way over to the mesh wire holding the tunnel in place and peer through the gaps in the vines to find countless mechanical birds perched on man-made branches.
lines.zh: 我走到固定住隧道的铁丝网边，透过藤蔓的缝隙往里看，看到数不清的机械鸟停在人造的枝头上。

lines.en: They notice our presence and look our way, pausing for a moment before opening their beaks in unison and singing a song together.
lines.zh: 它们察觉到我们，朝这边看过来，停了一瞬，然后齐齐张开喙，一起唱起一首歌。

lines.en: scene gpmexc3
: Oh my God...I think I {i}know{/i} this song. My mom used to hum it to me when I was just a baby.
lines.zh: : 我的天……我觉得我{i}听过{/i}这首歌。我还是婴儿的时候，我妈常哼给我听。

lines.en: : I think...mine did too. It feels familiar.
lines.zh: : 我想……我妈也是。感觉很熟悉。

lines.en: : Heheh, it’d be funny if we were actually related, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿，要是我们其实是亲戚，那就好笑了，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. We’d probably have to stop our date, though.
lines.zh: : 是啊。不过那样我们大概就得中止这次约会了。

lines.en: : I don’t mind if you don’t, Akira! Even if we were brother and sister, I’d want to keep being together. Plus, we could even share STD medications!
lines.zh: : 你不介意我就不介意，Akira！就算我们是兄妹，我也想继续在一起。而且我们还能共用治性病的药！

lines.en: : That does sound nice. Talking about STDs is sort of ruining the birds’ song, though. Can we focus for a second?
lines.zh: : 那听起来确实不错。不过聊性病有点毁掉这些鸟的歌了。我们能专心一会儿吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, you’re right. I’m sorry. Let’s keep listening.
lines.zh: : 对，你说得对。对不起。我们继续听吧。

lines.en: : So about us maybe possibly being related or something-
lines.zh: : 所以关于我们可能也许算是亲戚之类的——

lines.en: : Amy, the song’s still going.
lines.zh: : Amy，歌还在唱呢。

lines.en: : I know, I know! But thinking about this has gotten me all excited! And we’ll be able to hear their song the whole time we’re in this tunnel.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道！但一想到这个我就好兴奋！而且我们在隧道里的整段时间都能听到它们的歌。

lines.en: scene gpmexc2
: You know, they have family discounts at a {i}bunch{/i} of stores here! Vending machines too. You just have to scan your Family Badge.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，这里{i}好多{/i}店都有家庭折扣！自动贩卖机也是。你只要扫一下你的家庭徽章就行。

lines.en: : Family Badge?
lines.zh: : 家庭徽章？

lines.en: : Mhm! It’s like a credit card thingy you can sign up for in the Family Office, but there’s no money on it and you really just use it to get discounts on stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯！那是个像信用卡一样的东西，可以在家庭办事处办，但里面没钱，你就是拿它来打折买东西。

lines.en: : Think of it like a stamp card, but without all of the stamps. Buy a hundred sodas, get one free! That kind of stuff.
lines.zh: : 就当它是张集点卡，只不过不用集点。买一百瓶汽水，送一瓶！就那种。

lines.en: : You can get it in microchip form too if you don’t mind the needle. They put it in the back of your neck like you’re a cat. You can barely feel it.
lines.zh: : 如果你不怕打针，也可以做成芯片。他们把它打进你后颈，像给猫打那样。你几乎感觉不到。

lines.en: : Do you have one already? For you and your mom?
lines.zh: : 你已经有了吗？你和你妈的？

lines.en: : No. But I used to sell discount chips to people who didn’t want to pay the monthly fee. I made my own needle and everything! Wanna see?
lines.zh: : 没有。不过我从前会卖折扣芯片给那些不想付月费的人。针都是我自己做的，什么都是！要看吗？

lines.en: : No thank you, Amy. Let’s just continue down the tunnel.
lines.zh: : 不用了，Amy。我们就继续往隧道里走吧。

lines.en: : Okay! Whatever you want is fine with me, Akira!
lines.zh: : 好！你想怎样我都行，Akira！

lines.en: $ gpmexc = True
$ renpy.block_rollback()
continue
lines.zh: 继续

lines.en: jump gpmexj
turn back
lines.zh: 往回走

lines.en: jump gpmexi
dig
lines.zh: 挖

lines.en: jump gpmexa
$ renpy.block_rollback()
